about.text: Britain’s whipping cream: at least 35 % fat, enough to trap air when beaten and hold it as whipped cream.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Nothing is added: cream is standardised to the fat grade and pasteurised. Enough fat is what lets the beaten cream trap air and hold it.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

facts.v: Whipping cream 30–36 %; heavy whipping cream 36 % and above
